identity.title: List of Japanese language Best Wishes! home video releases

source.sourceCategory: Category:Lists of animation home video releases

leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! of the Pokémon animated series.
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! of the Pokémon animated series.

==Volume releases==
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! was divided into five sets that were released by Media Factory and Shogakukan from 2011 to 2014. It contains almost all the 144 episodes between them, except Dent and Takeshi! Gyarados's Imperial Rage!! and Iris VS Ibuki! The Road to Become a Dragon Master!!, special episodes aired after the series conclusion, and Afro GO! Buffron NO!!, which was released separately. All the DVDs were released for rental only.

===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes!===
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan from 2011 to 2012. It consists of 17 volumes with 50 episodes across them combined.

 

===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! 2012===
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! 2012 was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan in 2012. It consists of 12 volumes with 33 episodes across them combined.

Afro GO! Buffron NO!! was released separately. It is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Summer Bridge Story.

 

===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2===
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2 was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan in 2013. It consists of 8 volumes with 24 episodes across them combined.

 

===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Episode N===
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Episode N was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan in 2013. It consists of 5 volumes with 14 episodes across them combined.

 

===Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Decolora Adventure!===
Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! Season 2: Decolora Adventure! was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan from 2013 to 2014. It consists of 7 volumes with 20 episodes across them combined.

Dent and Takeshi! Gyarados's Imperial Rage!! and Iris VS Ibuki! The Road to Become a Dragon Master!! were not released on DVD.

 

==Special releases==
Afro GO! Buffron NO!! was released by Media Factory and Shogakukan as part of a special set.

 

===Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD===
(Japanese: ポケモンTVアニメコレクションDVD Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD) had four sets released during Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! from 2011 to 2012. Each set contains eight DVDs, with each DVD containing one Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! episode and one original series episode.

====A New Journey!====
 
(Japanese: ポケモンTVアニメコレクションDVD ～新たなる旅立ち！編～ Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD: A New Journey!) was released on August 3, 2011.

 

====Pokémon Battle====
 
(Japanese: ポケモンTVアニメコレクションDVD ～ポケモンバトル編～ Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD: Pokémon Battle) was released on January 18, 2012.

 

====Waku-Waku! Doki-Doki!!====
 
(Japanese: ポケモンTVアニメコレクションDVD ～ワクワク！ドキドキ！！編～ Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD: Waku-Waku! Doki-Doki!!) was released on July 24, 2012.

 

====Aim to Be a Pokémon Master!====
 
(Japanese: ポケモンTVアニメコレクションDVD ～めざせポケモンマスター！編～ Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD: Aim to Be a Pokémon Master!) was released on November 6, 2012.

 

==Trivia==
 
Pokémon TV Anime Collection DVD: Pokémon Battle contents were changed since it was announced. The original promotional images showed Everyone Gathers! Don Battle!! on disc 8. In the final release, the Pocket Monsters Best Wishes! episodes from discs 3 through 7 were moved one disc ahead (4 through 8) and A Sommelier Showdown! Ishizumai VS Futachimaru!! was included on disc 3. The original series episodes were not affected.
